packaging: Exact raw results retained; parsed JSON removes only terminal literal backslash+n. Scripts/logs byte-exact; embedded script hashes verified.
boundaries: macOS host writer/Docker Desktop Linux readonly reader
limitations: Primitive only; no graph/manifest lifecycle implementation proof
Stat/nlink/path visibility may change or be cached; exact bytes/hash are the invariant
Process exit implies OS FD cleanup, not an observed physical disk reclaim measurement
No global hard disk bound across arbitrary active readonly processes
